content: Slice audited: cli-core (packages/cli-core/cliapp, packages/cli-core/cliutil, scenarios/prompt-manager/cli bootstrap). Top finding: structured API recovery metadata is parsed and tested in cli-core but flattened in user-facing CLI errors. Evidence: packages/cli-core/cliutil/httpclient.go defines APIError fields and FormatConcise, returns ParseAPIError for HTTP >=400; packages/cli-core/cliutil/apiclient_test.go tests structured parse/format; scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/main.go prints app.Run errors with raw %v. Measured fixture: prompt-manager status against a local HTTP 400 JSON body with code, recovery_hint, and manual_steps exited 1 and printed only Last error: api error (400): fixture failure. Verification: go test ./cliutil ./cliapp in packages/cli-core passed; go test ./... in scenarios/prompt-manager/cli passed. Grades: architecture B, security B, test coverage B, documentation B-, cross-platform C+, signal C, instrumentation C.
